args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 rounded
to 2.67 instead of 2.66). Fix by quantizing with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Change
- Quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Closes the nightly build failure; needs to ship in today's release.
